title: centaurea langei subsp. coutinhoi
intro: Centaurea langei subsp. coutinhoi, commonly known as Coutinho's knapweed, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and research has revealed its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Coutinho's knapweed include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
